subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a built-in Control UI cron calendar timeline now, or leave the linked calendar-view request open for a future/current-main redesign?
rationale: The PR is a feature with good UI proof but needs a substantial rebase and product ownership before a large built-in cron visualization lands in core Control UI.

options.title: Sponsor and repair the built-in timeline
options.body: Treat this as the candidate direction, require a rebase onto current cron UI modules, and fix the compatibility/scheduling/i18n blockers before merge.

options.title: Keep the request open, close or pause this branch
options.body: If maintainers do not want this built-in timeline now, keep the canonical issue as product backlog and avoid carrying this stale conflicting branch.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and repair the built-in timeline
recommendation.body: Treat this as the candidate direction, require a rebase onto current cron UI modules, and fix the compatibility/scheduling/i18n blockers before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision most directly affects the current Control UI cron surface that recent history shows `shakkernerd` refactored and maintained.
